positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I spent 9 months working on the Eats Data Solutions team ensuring that Eats teams across the globe have efficient, reliable access to all of the data they need. This included offline data modelling (Hive, Spark, Scala, SQL, Python) as well as resource management (YARN, HDFS).

In early 2020 I moved into the Eats Prediction team working as a backend engineer focussed on all things time prediction for the Eats business (Golang).

positions.title: Marketplace Efficiency (Ops)
positions.description:
I work to ensure the operational efficiency of the Uber Eats platform in Queensland. I consistently seek out opportunities to gain technical knowledge and experience outside of the scope of my job, in particular: 
- machine learning
- product analysis
- task automation
- data architecture & engineering

positions.title: Restaurant Partnerships (Sales)
positions.description:
As a part of the expansion team, I was involved in the launch of Uber Eats in 6 new markets across Australia. During this time I also undertook self-driven side projects; often writing scripts and programs with the aim of automating time consuming tasks for the whole team.

Tools used:
- JavaScript
- GoogleApp Suite
- Python
- Various other public APIs

volunteerExperiences.description: Over the course of the 2014 Mercedes-Benz Fashion Festival I assisted as a volunteer. In this role I was responsible for liaising with attendees of the festival and assisting with any issues they may have.
